# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user nginx;
worker_processes 4;

events {
    worker_connections 1024;
}

http {
    upstream app_backend {
        server 10.1.1.100:8080 max_fails=3;
        server 10.1.1.101:8080 backup;
    }

    include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/site-a.conf:
server {
    listen 443 ssl default_server;
    listen 80;
    server_name a.example.com www.a.example.com;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://app_backend;
    }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/site-b.conf:
server {
    listen 10.0.0.5:443 ssl;
    server_name b.example.com *.b.example.com;
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://10.1.1.100:9090/api;
    }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/legacy.conf:
server {
    listen 8081;
    # no server_name, no pass — static legacy site
}
